enum_items.name: Round
enum_items.description: Round the float up or down to the nearest integer

enum_items.name: Floor
enum_items.description: Round the float down to the next smallest integer

enum_items.name: Ceiling
enum_items.description: Round the float up to the next largest integer

enum_items.name: Truncate
enum_items.description: Round the float to the closest integer in the direction of zero (floor if positive; ceiling if negative)
